doc.title: Adafruit BME280 Humidity + Barometric Pressure + Temperature Sensor Breakout: Pinouts and rev C Schematic (JP1)
doc.revision: Adafruit BME280 STEMMA QT rev C (schematic 2020-07-20; Pinouts guide last edited 2024-03-08)
doc.pinNumbering: Pins 1-7 match header JP1 on the rev C schematic and left-to-right silkscreen order on the PCB (VIN, 3Vo, GND, SCK, SDO, SDI, CS).
doc.notes: On-board 3.3 V regulator (AP2112K-3.3) accepts 3-5 V on VIN and supplies 3.3 V (up to 100 mA) on 3Vo. SCK and SDI have BSS138 level-shifters and 10 kOhm pull-ups and serve both SPI (SCK/MOSI) and I2C (SCL/SDA). SDO is SPI MISO and sets the I2C address (default 0x77, pull to GND for 0x76). CS is SPI chip select (leave unconnected for I2C).
